editorial:
Ever wondered what it would be like to visit the very beginning of Japan? You get to experience that magic when Nobita and his crew jump back in time to a world of prehistoric nature and early tribes. You will meet Kukuru, a lonely boy who has had a rough life, and watch as the gang forms a deep bond with him. The whole vibe is a mix of a cozy friendship story and a big, scary adventure. It feels like a giant field trip where everything can go wrong, but the heart of the story is all about helping someone who has nothing.

The action scenes are exciting, and the contrast between Doraemon's futuristic gadgets and the stone age is honestly hilarious. While some parts of the plot move a bit slowly in the middle, the emotional payoff at the end makes it worth it. You should definitely watch this if you want something that feels warm and inspiring. To get the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video so the bright colors really pop, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection if you are a big fan.
endingExplained: The gang faces off against Gigazombie, who was actually a criminal from the future using advanced tech to rule the past. After a big fight, they defeat him and save the tribe. The saddest part is when Nobita and his friends have to return to their own time, leaving Kukuru behind. However, you learn that Kukuru grows up to be a great leader, ensuring his people have a bright and peaceful future because of the kindness Nobita showed him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves friendship stories and time travel adventures.
